items.title: Aflac (NYSE:AFL) misses Q3 2026 revenue estimates
items.summary: Supplemental insurance provider Aflac (NYSE:AFL) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with revenue falling 25.8% year on year to $3.27 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.43 per share was 35.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
